text:
Maria G: Heads-up — we should schedule a postmortem for INC-2026 (customer latency spike, 2026-03-15 01:12 UTC). Looking for a facilitator and a 60-min slot next week. Any volunteers? TL;DR: spike during deploy, partial regional impact, fallback applied, customers saw 5–20s tail latency.
incident-bot: Incident summary: INC-2026 created by paging. Severity: sev2. Timeline & raw alerts attached → https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026
Tom H: I can facilitate. Tue/Wed mornings PST work for me. Happy to run the timeline and keep it timeboxed.
Jess A: I’ll attend and can prep customer-impact notes. Prefer Wed 16:00 UTC if that helps.
Owen K: Can be backup facilitator. Tue 15:00 UTC also ok. Can help with the mitigation timeline.
Lisa S: SRE will join. I can take meeting notes/action tracker. Will pull logs before the meeting.
Maria G: Thanks — creating a quick poll: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 — please mark availability by EOD Thu. Want to lock facilitator by Friday.
Tom H: Already marked poll. Quick Q: do we want a separate 30-min pre-read sync for owners? Could be async.
Jess A: Async pre-read is fine. I’ll draft a 1-pager with customer impact + suggested comms and drop in the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/INC-2026/pre-read
Owen K: +1 for async. I can assemble the timeline entries from the deploy logs. Putting a note in the doc.
Lisa S: Action items I’ll own in the tracker: gather tail latency histograms, list affected regions, attach pod logs.
Maria G: Proposed roles: Facilitator = Tom H, Backup = Owen K, Recorder = Lisa S, PM (customer comms) = Jess A. Any objections? :point_up:
Tom H: Ok with roles. I’ll run the agenda: 1) timeline 2) impact 3) root-cause hypotheses 4) action items. 60 min.
Jess A: Sounds good. I’ll prepare the comms draft and bring examples of affected customers (no PII in doc).
Owen K: I’ll prep a short slide on deploy artifacts and config changes that were live during the window.
Lisa S: Noted. I’ll add tasks in the tracker and assign owners. Will include links to dashboards and logs.
Tom H: Also can we invite platform infra and product owners for the affected feature? Maria, can you add them?
Maria G: Yes — adding @platform-lead and @product-owner to invite list. Also request that infra bring any infra-level mitigations we applied.
Jess A: One more ask — record the meeting and capture a short executive summary for leadership. I can draft it post-meeting.
Maria G: Locking facilitator: Tom H (backup Owen K). Meeting invite + Zoom will go out Friday afternoon once poll closes. Pre-read deadline: add notes to pre-read doc by EOD Friday. 
Tom H: FYI I’ll keep the meeting locked to internal attendees only — will surface any needed external comms in the exec summary.
Lisa S: Ack. Adding initial action items to tracker now. Everyone please add any supporting artifacts to the pre-read doc.
Maria G: Thanks all — small checklist: 1) fill poll 2) add pre-read notes 3) owners confirm tasks in tracker. Will post invite + link once done. :thumbsup:
Jess A: ✅ will add comms draft by Friday.
Owen K: ✅ will add timeline entries.
Tom H: ✅ will prepare agenda + timebox.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: poll closes in 36h. Pinning this thread to #incidents for visibility.
Maria G: Closing thread — will follow up with calendar invite. If anything urgent before that, ping me or Tom directly.
